current_execution.activation_entrypoints: hard-disabled before input reads or writes

pre_effect_input_read_policy.root_intent_and_slot: open from held parent with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NOATIME|O_CLOEXEC; inspect F_GETFL for O_NOATIME before pread; compare atime before/after; refuse if O_NOATIME unavailable or denied
pre_effect_input_read_policy.selected_host_requirement: reproduce no-atime behavior on selected filesystem/mount with exact held input paths before authorization; no input-atime change is permitted in a selected effect
pre_effect_input_read_policy.disposable_observation: 30-day-old Root and slot fixture atimes remained byte-identical through held reads in both normal and optimized test runs
pre_effect_input_read_policy.other_preflight_reads: account, snapshot, unit, mount and journal reads remain outside this four-entry manifest and require separately selected effect accounting

preconditions_before_any_future_effect: exact administrator authorization and fresh preimages selected
root:root 0700 instances and custody parents, held by nofollow descriptors on selected host filesystem and mount
no writable ancestor, ACL, alias, inherited parent descriptor, or capable untrusted peer
dedicated service UID/GID selected and distinct from root
verified Root intent issuer and current period bound to exact held bytes
continuously held slot lock and epoch bound to exact held bytes and inode
installed sole-writer namespace, proc and FD denial independently reviewed
held-child bind mechanism selected and independently tested

future_single_broker_attempt_only_after_.child_metadata_change: root:root 0700 at creation; fchown held inode to selected service UID/GID only after empty preimage verification; directory scan can update this new child's atime
future_single_broker_attempt_only_after_.durability_order: slot claim file and parent fsync; intent claim file and parent fsync; child inode and instances parent fsync; prepared record file and custody parent fsync

rollback.before_slot_claim: no broker entry to remove; retain failed preflight evidence
rollback.after_slot_claim_or_child_creation: quarantine and retain claim, child, and partial records; no automatic deletion, epoch replay, or slot release
rollback.after_prepared_record: separate owner-approved reconciliation only after service and descendants are stopped and retained evidence has been reviewed

outside_this_manifest: five root storage directories plus snapshot paths
unit, snapshot, socket, mount, cgroup, journal, and disposable probe effects
protected family, issuer, Reader, Mapper, and Context effects
